mapper.select: SELECT id, enterprise_id, user_id, scale_id, scale_snapshot, content_hash, status, revision, answers_json, result_json, consent_at, submitted_at, create_time, update_time FROM assessment_session WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE assessment_session SET answers_json = #{answers}, revision = revision + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND revision = #{revision}
